fields.description: Configuration bitflags loaded from EEPROM at boot
fields.evidence: FUN_080659e4 reads 4 save halfwords through FUN_08065964 from DAT_0d000000 (EEPROM) into RAM at param_2+6; baseline halfword at raw offset 5 decodes via that path.
fields.name: config_option_bits

fields.description: Season/career progress counter persisted to EEPROM
fields.evidence: FUN_080659e4 bounds param_1 against table limit then shifts save halfwords into RAM; FUN_08065aa8 serializes the matching RAM halfwords back via FUN_08065964 to DAT_0d000000.
fields.name: season_progress

fields.description: Team stats block persisted through the EEPROM read/write path
fields.evidence: FUN_080659e4 bulk-loads save halfwords from DAT_0d000000 into RAM and FUN_08065aa8 writes the same width block back through FUN_08065964; raw offsets 9..17 sit inside that active EEPROM window.
fields.name: team_stats_block

fields.description: Match settings value persisted to EEPROM
fields.evidence: FUN_08065aa8 serializes RAM halfwords bit-by-bit into the EEPROM stream via FUN_08065964 to DAT_0d000000; FUN_080659e4 reconstructs them on load. Baseline raw offset 25 reads 240.
fields.name: match_settings

fields.description: Tournament stage counter persisted to EEPROM
fields.evidence: FUN_080659e4 shifts EEPROM bits from DAT_0d000000 into RAM halfwords and FUN_08065aa8 performs the inverse store; raw offset 29 baseline value 3840 sits in that window.
fields.name: tournament_stage

fields.evidence: FUN_08065aa8 writes RAM halfwords to DAT_0d000000 through FUN_08065964 and FUN_080659e4 reads them back; raw offset 35 baseline value 62 is inside the active range.
fields.name: unlock_count
